question_text: Which of the following is a hormone-releasing intrauterine device (IUD)?
explanation:
LNG-20 is a hormone-releasing intrauterine device (IUD) that makes the uterus unsuitable for
              implantation.
subject: Biology

question_text: Which of the following conditions is NOT caused by a sexually transmitted infection (STI)?
explanation:
Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection that primarily affects the lungs and is not a sexually transmitted
              infection.
subject: Biology

question_text: Which of the following statements regarding assisted reproductive technology (ART) is correct?

options.text:
(1)
IVF involves fertilization inside the female body.

(2)
ICSI is used when the male partner has a very low sperm count.

(3)
GIFT involves transferring an embryo into the uterus.

(4)
ZIFT is a natural method of conception.

explanation:
ICSI (Intra-Cytoplasmic Sperm Injection) is an ART technique used when the male partner has a very low
              sperm count.
subject: Biology
